card.name: Digits 0 and 5 inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 0 or 5, in the middle or end of a multi-digit number. It is typically in a dose, concentration or volume such as 200 mg/5 mL.

modes.label: Zero in a larger number
modes.description: The digit 0 inside a number such as 40, 80 or 200 before a unit or percent sign.

modes.label: Five in a volume or strength
modes.description: The digit 5 in a per-volume figure such as 5 mL or 2.5 mL.

card.plain: It fires on the digits 0 or 5 inside numbers such as strengths and volumes, for example 100 mg per 5 mL.
